items.excerpt: 🗣Terence Tao: The race to AGI is becoming a bit toxic and a bit scary. “We’re not only sacrificing understanding, we’re also sacrificing safety.” “When these tools are just chatbots, it can be charming if they make mistakes. But now we’re putting them in charge of reward systems.” “A lot of junior research projects just got wiped out overnight.” “One or two papers even had errors and were retracted.” “We don’t have a clear picture of what’s going on, and no one from OpenAI is helping us.” 🏴
